verdict.rationale: Devin exposes a conversational interface via its own embedded IDE within cloud sessions (devin-docs-3) and its Desktop app that imports VS Code/Cursor settings (devin-docs-9), plus an MCP server letting 'any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE' access sessions (devin-docs-6/23). However there's no evidence of a native extension that lets a developer chat with Devin directly inside their own existing IDE (e.g., a VS Code/JetBrains plugin) — Devin's model is its own IDE/Desktop environment or MCP bridging rather than embedding in the user's IDE. Missing for 10: a first-party IDE extension for VS Code/JetBrains enabling in-IDE chat, and independent confirmation of this workflow working well in practice.
